sections.title: Inputs And Discovery
sections.text: Only refs is accepted: a nonempty array. Discover with entity.list {kind:body}, {kind:occurrence}, {kind:sketch}, {kind:plane}, {kind:axis} or {kind:point}; reuse result.entities[i]. A reference is an exact unique name/alias or {token:string,kind?:string,name?:string,component?:reference,occurrence?:reference,path?:string}. Token overrides stale name, not kind/context; path disambiguates occurrences. Bodies resolve in the scoped component; occurrence context can create proxies. Explicit reference.component clears inherited occurrence scope. Targets must expose isLightBulbOn; no additional proxy rejection. Requires scoped open Design.

sections.title: Safety
sections.text: Resolves all refs/checks bulb support before setting each true, without deduplication or ancestor/folder changes. Effective visibility need not become true. A setter failure can leave earlier changes; no rollback or document save.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: Under result: restoreState:{document:{creationId:string,name:string,dataFileId:string|null},items:[{ref:reference,isLightBulbOn:boolean}]}, items:[{ref:reference,isLightBulbOn:boolean,isVisible:boolean|null}], limitations:string[]. Returned references contain token:string|null,kind:string,name:string|null, optional component/occurrence refs and path; root is {kind:component,name:root}. Normal execution wrapper:{success:boolean,operation:string,document:string,result:object,created:reference[]}. Wire show.result.restoreState to visibility.restore.state. Restore identity includes name/dataFileId, so rename or save can invalidate it.

examples.output: result.items[0].isLightBulbOn=true; retain result.restoreState.

sections.title: Inputs And Discovery
sections.text: Only refs:nonempty array. Discover with entity.list kind body/occurrence/sketch/plane/axis/point and reuse result.entities[i] references: token/kind/name, optional component/occurrence/path. Exact names/aliases must match uniquely. Body/geometry names use scoped component; occurrence scope can produce proxies; explicit reference.component clears inherited occurrence scope. Only targets with isLightBulbOn accepted; no additional native/proxy restriction. Requires scoped open Design.

sections.title: Safety
sections.text: Resolves all refs and checks bulb support before setting each false. No deduplication, ancestor/folder changes, suppression, deletion or save. Runtime failure may leave partial bulb changes, no rollback.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result:{restoreState:{document:{creationId:string,name:string,dataFileId:string|null},items:[{ref:reference,isLightBulbOn:boolean}]},items:[{ref:reference,isLightBulbOn:boolean,isVisible:boolean|null}],limitations:string[]}. Reference objects normally contain token:string|null,kind:string,name:string|null with optional component/occurrence/path; root is {kind:component,name:root}. Wrapper:{success:boolean,operation:string,document:string,result:object,created:reference[]}. Feed hide.result.restoreState to visibility.restore.state; document name/dataFileId as well as creationId must remain unchanged.

sections.title: State Schema
sections.text: Only state accepted: pass earlier visibility operation result.restoreState unchanged. Schema:{document:{creationId:string,name:string,dataFileId:string|null},items:[{ref:reference,isLightBulbOn:boolean}]}. All identity values must equal scoped document; rename/first save can invalidate it. items may be empty, booleans must be JSON booleans. Nested extra keys are not rejected, but do not alter generated state. Ref is a returned token/kind/name/context object or exact unique name. Tokens resolve in this Design only; use same component/occurrence context as capture.

sections.title: Safety
sections.text: All refs/bulb support checked before setters. Runtime setter failure can leave partial restore; no rollback, ancestor changes, effective visibility guarantee or save. The handler itself has no active-viewport prerequisite.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result:{restoreState:same state schema (immediately before restore),items:[{ref:reference,isLightBulbOn:boolean,isVisible:boolean|null}],limitations:string[]}. Returned refs have token/kind/name, optional component/occurrence/path; root uses kind:component,name:root. Normal wrapper includes success,operation,document,result,created. Returned restoreState can reverse this restore; it is not a saved checkpoint.

sections.title: Inputs And Scope
sections.text: Only refs and scope, both nonempty arrays. Every resolved selected entity must occur in resolved scope (entity equality, not token-string equality). Discover siblings with entity.list kind body or occurrence and explicitly select full intended scope. Reuse result.entities[i] token/kind/name/component/occurrence/path refs or exact unique names. Body names use component scope; occurrence context may create proxies; explicit reference.component clears inherited occurrence scope. Selection and scope must resolve to matching contexts; all targets need isLightBulbOn.

sections.title: Safety
sections.text: Selected scope bulbs become true; remaining scope bulbs false. All resolution/support checks precede writes; no deduplication or hierarchy inference. Use siblings: a hidden parent can still hide a selected child. Folders/ancestors untouched; runtime failure can leave partial changes, no rollback or save. Requires scoped open Design.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result:{restoreState:{document:{creationId:string,name:string,dataFileId:string|null},items:[{ref:reference,isLightBulbOn:boolean}]},items:[{ref:reference,isLightBulbOn:boolean,isVisible:boolean|null}],limitations:string[]}. Rows follow scope order and retain duplicates. Wrapper includes success,operation,document,result,created. Wire isolate.result.restoreState into visibility.restore.state in same identity/context; rename/save may invalidate identity. Refs contain token/kind/name with optional component/occurrence/path.

examples.output: result.items[0] bulb=true and items[1] bulb=false; retain restoreState.

sections.title: Prerequisites
sections.text: Input {} only. Scoped open Design must already be active and own activeViewport. No activation, camera setters, document save or named-view persistence. Orthographic capture requires working Camera.getExtents. Only the three returned camera types are supported.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result:{state:{document:{creationId:string,name:string,dataFileId:string|null},eye:number[3],target:number[3],up:number[3],cameraType:string,units:cm,extents?:number[2],perspectiveAngle?:number}}. OrthographicCameraType uses positive width/height cm extents; PerspectiveCameraType/PerspectiveWithOrthoFacesCameraType use radians perspectiveAngle, no extents. eye/target are world-space cm, up unitless; evaluated snapshots, not driving expressions. Wrapper includes success,operation,document,result,created. Wire save.result.state into camera.restore.state unchanged. Identity includes name/dataFileId, so rename/save can invalidate it. Aspect changes can prevent pixel-identical restoration.

sections.title: State Schema
sections.text: Only state accepted; use camera.save.result.state or camera operation result.restoreState. Required document:{creationId:string,name:string,dataFileId:string|null},units:cm,cameraType:OrthographicCameraType|PerspectiveCameraType|PerspectiveWithOrthoFacesCameraType,eye/target:three finite numeric cm values each,up:three finite numeric unitless components with nonzero norm. Eye != target; normalized up cannot be parallel/antiparallel to sight (absolute dot >1-1e-9 rejected). Orthographic requires extents:[positive finite widthCm,heightCm]; other types require numeric perspectiveAngle strictly between 0 and pi radians. Snapshots use evaluated numbers, not expressions. Nested extras not rejected; pass generated state unchanged.

sections.title: Safety
sections.text: Document identity must exactly match including name/dataFileId; scoped document must already be active and own viewport. Projection/FOV committed first, then reread before explicit pose/extents; fit/smooth transition disabled. Validation before setters; apply failure attempts rollback, which can also fail and is reported. No save/named view; native aspect adaptation can change framing.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result:{restoreState:snapshot,state:snapshot,limitations:string[]}. Both use above schema, only projection-appropriate extents or perspectiveAngle. restoreState is before, state actual read-back after. Wrapper includes success,operation,document,result,created. Another camera.restore with this result.restoreState reverses the change; it is not a visibility state.

examples.output: result.state is read-back view; result.restoreState is replaced view.

two-stage lens/pose application and rollback failures

sections.title: Input Modes
sections.text: At least one setting required; only orientation,eye,target,up,projection,extents,perspectiveAngle,fit. orientation:front/back/top/bottom/left/right/iso-top-left/iso-top-right/iso-bottom-left/iso-bottom-right, exclusive with eye/up but combinable with target/extents/fit. eye/target independently optional arrays of three length-expression strings; omitted values retain prior snapshot. up:three finite nonzero numeric unitless components normalized on apply, not parallel to sight. projection:orthographic|perspective; omission preserves current type including hybrid. Switching to orthographic requires extents:[positive widthExpression,heightExpression]; switching to perspective requires perspectiveAngle expression strictly between 0 and 180 deg. extents forbidden for perspective, perspectiveAngle forbidden for orthographic. Same-projection omitted framing retains prior values. fit:boolean default false, {fit:false} accepted.

sections.title: Units And Safety
sections.text: Dimensional expressions must be nonempty strings with explicit units or existing parameter references; bare numbers/dimensionless values rejected. Evaluated now in cm/rad, not driving dependencies. Eye/target world-space; native perspectiveAngle has no inferred horizontal/vertical conversion. The CLI mutating wrapper activates the exact scoped document in the same SDK turn before handler validation; the handler still requires that document to own the active viewport. Read-only camera.save does not activate a document. Explicit pose must be valid even with fit=true. Orientation applies after preparation; fit may override framing. Projection/FOV settle before pose. Validation precedes camera setters; apply failure attempts camera rollback (can also fail). No saved view/document save; framing needs live review.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result:{restoreState:snapshot,state:snapshot,limitations:string[]}. Snapshot:{document:{creationId:string,name:string,dataFileId:string|null},eye:number[3],target:number[3],up:number[3],cameraType:string,units:cm,extents?:number[2],perspectiveAngle?:number}. OrthographicCameraType returns width/height cm extents; PerspectiveCameraType/PerspectiveWithOrthoFacesCameraType return radians angle. state is actual read-back, restoreState is before. Wrapper includes success,operation,document,result,created. Wire set.result.restoreState to camera.restore.state with unchanged document identity.

sections.title: Nested Inputs
sections.text: shots:nonempty array of {path:string,camera?:object,visibility?:[{ref,isLightBulbOn}],sections?:[{name,isLightBulbOn}],activeComponent?:reference,width?:integer,height?:integer}; no other nested keys. Outer overwrite/confirm booleans default false, both true for existing files. Paths absolute on Fusion host with existing parent, distinct after resolved-path normalization, .png/.jpg/.jpeg/.bmp/.tif/.tiff case-insensitive; output symlinks/directories rejected. width/height each integer 0..16384, default 0 uses viewport dimension; booleans rejected. visibility rows accept {ref,isLightBulbOn:boolean} only; sections rows accept {name,isLightBulbOn:boolean} only; activeComponent resolves to a component/occurrence. No pixel-product limit enforced here.

sections.title: Camera And Safety
sections.text: Scoped document already active and owning viewport required. camera accepts nonempty camera.set settings: orientation enum front/back/top/bottom/left/right/iso-top-left/iso-top-right/iso-bottom-left/iso-bottom-right exclusive with eye/up but combinable with target/extents/fit; eye/target three length-expression strings, up three finite nonzero unitless numbers not parallel to sight; projection orthographic/perspective, extents two positive length expressions for orthographic, perspectiveAngle angle expression between 0 and 180 deg for perspective. Switching projection requires matching framing. fit boolean default false. Per-shot presentation: visibility nonempty [{ref,isLightBulbOn:boolean}], sections nonempty [{name,isLightBulbOn:boolean}], activeComponent component/occurrence ref to activate. Dimensions/paths prevalidated for all shots; camera and presentation validated only when its shot runs. Omitted camera retains preceding view. Earlier files remain on later failure. finally attempts restoration of the original camera plus any touched visibility, section and active-component state (listed entities and their occurrence parents); complete restoration is not guaranteed. If cleanup succeeds, the primary exception is re-raised unchanged. Cleanup failure raises RuntimeError with text I/O cleanup failed: followed by JSON {primaryError:null|{type,message},cleanupErrors:[{action,type,message}]}; action is Restore original camera or the presentation restore action. The original primary exception is retained as __cause__, or the first cleanup exception if no primary exists. No file or geometry rollback, metric validation or save. CLI maps paths; host must have actual parent directory.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result:{images:[{path:string,exists:true,bytes:positive integer,pathHost:machine running Fusion,geometryVerified:false,camera:snapshot}],restoreState:snapshot,cameraRestored:true}. Snapshot:{document:{creationId:string,name:string,dataFileId:string|null},eye:number[3],target:number[3],up:number[3],cameraType:string,units:cm,extents?:number[2],perspectiveAngle?:number}; orthographic extents width/height cm, perspective/hybrid angle radians. No success result for missing/empty image or restore failure. Wrapper includes success,operation,document,result,created. Wire pack.result.images.0.path and .1.path to view.compare.left/right.

sections.text: Requires left/right absolute existing Fusion-host image paths; optional mode defaults pair, only pair supported. Case-insensitive .png/.jpg/.jpeg/.bmp/.tif/.tiff. sections.title: Mode Schemas And Discovery
sections.text: mode:create|show|hide|helper and nonempty name:string required. create also plane:reference, optional offset:length-expression default 0 mm, visible:boolean default true. show/hide only mode/name, exactly one existing section name. helper requires plane and offset, forbids visible. Real section names unique across design analyses; helper names unique in scoped component constructionPlanes. Discover sections in Fusion Analyses browser (entity.list does not enumerate them). Plane refs: reserved scoped XY/XZ/YZ, entity.list {kind:plane} result.entities[i], or entity.find {kind:face,filters:{geometry:plane}} refs. Token/kind/name/component/occurrence/path resolve with normal component/proxy context; no extra proxy guard.

sections.title: Safety And Semantics
sections.text: Real analyses require installed analyses.sectionAnalyses; create additionally createInput/add, otherwise create via Inspect > Section Analysis UI then show. Face kind checked, native API validates planarity/feasibility. Real offset evaluated to signed cm now, no driving dependency. Helper delegates datum.plane offset mode: validates expression and passes ValueInput, uses scoped component and creationOccurrence if present; construction helper is not clipping. No replacing/deleting or token-based section show/hide. Only section bulb changes, never shared Analyses folder. Post-add/name/visibility failure can leave section/helper; no rollback/save.

Wrapper includes success,operation,document,result,created; create/helper append new ref. Use helper.result.entity as subsequent plane ref; operate real sections by exact name.

sections.title: Inputs And Discovery
sections.text: mode:calibrate only; requires ref:Canvas reference,segment:[[lengthString,lengthString],[lengthString,lengthString]],length:positive length expression,anchor:[lengthString,lengthString]; angle:angle expression default 0 deg. Expressions require units/existing parameter references, evaluated now in cm/rad, not driving dependencies. Segment is two distinct caller-measured current canvas-plane points, NOT pixels. Anchor is desired first endpoint; angle desired segment direction. Insert > Canvas first, select Canvas, then selection.inspect {} in active scoped document. Use result.selections[i].entity actual token reference. entity.list/name search do not enumerate canvases; actual kind is Canvas, not canvas. No fabricated token is usable.

sections.title: Safety
sections.text: Uniform plane-space similarity (scale=known/measured length) left-composes existing Matrix2D with rotation/translation. All matrix cells prepared before canvas.transform setter. No additional native/proxy guard beyond resolver/API feasibility. No insertion, distortion correction, pixel calibration, independent metrology or rollback. previousTransform is informational, not accepted by a restore operation. Scope should match selected canvas; live visual/metric review remains necessary.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result:{ref:reference,previousTransform:number[9],transform:number[9],calibration:{lengthCm:number,scaleFactor:number,anchorCm:number[2]},metricVerification:false,limitations:string[]}. Arrays follow native Matrix2D.asArray order, row-major 3x3, plane translations cm. transform read after setter; no angle field returned. Ref has token:string|null,kind:Canvas,name:string|null and optional owner/context refs. Wrapper includes success,operation,document,result,created.

sections.text: Only optional library:nonempty exact loaded library ID string and search:string, case-insensitive name substring default empty. Omit library for local scoped Design appearances. Start {} for local items and loaded library IDs, then query chosen result.libraries[i].id. No download/load, physical material/mass query or mutation; Design must be open, not necessarily active. IDs preserved verbatim, not display names.

sections.title: Inputs And Scope
sections.text: Requires refs:nonempty array,id:nonempty exact appearance ID; optional library:nonempty loaded ID,includeChildren:boolean default false. No confirm/overwrite. Discover entity.list kind body/component/occurrence or entity.find kind face; reuse result.entities[i] token/kind/name with component/occurrence/path. Unique names/aliases supported. Body/face scope is component, occurrence context may produce proxies; explicit reference.component requests native scope. Mutation rejects assemblyContext or different nativeObject proxies. Native occurrences get instance overrides, body/face definitions shared. Components expand to current direct BRepBodies; includeChildren true traverses descendants/deduplicates bodies. Supplying includeChildren even false requires a Component selection. No future-body or automatic face/occurrence clearing.

sections.title: Library Workflow And Safety
sections.text: appearance.list {} discovers local IDs and libraries; query discovered library for foreign items. Pass both library and foreign id. Local ID OR name collision rejects copy, without equivalence assumptions; choose local id without library instead. All target/ID/collision checks before writes. Copied local ID may differ: reuse assign.result.id WITHOUT library later. Empty component cascade gives count=0, no copy. Runtime failure may leave copy/earlier assignments; no rollback. Visual only, not material/coating; face/occurrence overrides can mask body edits.

sections.title: Inputs And Interpretation
sections.text: Requires refs:nonempty array; optional includeChildren:boolean false. No library/id. Discover entity.list kind body/component/occurrence or entity.find kind face; reuse result.entities[i] token/kind/name/component/occurrence/path refs or exact unique names. Components expand direct bodies, descendants with includeChildren true, deduplicated; explicitly supplying flag requires a Component even if false. Persistent valid proxies allowed for read; transient bodies/unsupported kinds rejected. BodyAppearanceSource is body override on body but inheritance on face; FaceAppearanceSource face override, OverrideAppearanceSource generic override. Material/occurrence source on body/face inherited. Proxy typed overrides report native-definition; generic proxy override proxy-context-unspecified. Unknown status null. Occurrence appearance null means contents, not uniform effective style. No writes, copies, mass calculation or rendered-color guarantee.

sections.text: result:{kind:appearance,action:inspect,count:integer,mapping:[{selected:reference,scope:component-body-cascade|instance|definition,targets:reference[],count:integer}],affectedDefinitions:reference[],affectedDefinitionCount:integer,includeChildren:boolean,atomic:false,limitations:string[],affected:[{ref:reference,before:state,after:state}],items:state[]}. before=after. No requested/copiedStyle/id/assigned/previous. State:{ref:reference,scope:definition|instance|proxy-read-only,definition:reference|null,appearance:null|{id:string,name:string},appearanceSource:string|null,appearanceOverride:boolean|null,appearanceOverrideScope:definition|native-definition|proxy-context-unspecified|instance|null,material:null|{id:string,name:string},materialReadFrom:reference,materialSource:BRepBody.material|Component.material,materialInheritance:string}. sections.title: Inputs And Safety

Invalid dimensions, nonpositive values and invalid STL units fail before native option creation or export. STLExportOptions.surfaceDeviation is assigned after option creation; its SDK setter automatically selects MeshRefinementCustom. No other tessellation knobs. Omission leaves SDK default medium refinement unchanged.

File-only accepts only path/reimport, rejects ref/lengthTolerance/volumeTolerance; any suffix, missing/nonregular path reported rather than error, zero bytes allowed. reimport:true requires nonempty existing .step/.stp/.f3d/.iges/.igs/.sat/.smt supported importer, not mesh/F3Z. Optional ref Component, default ctx.component; discover entity.list {kind:component} result.entities[i] or root. Optional lengthTolerance:nonnegative length-expression default 0.01 mm, evaluated cm; explicit units/existing parameter reference, no bare numeric values. volumeTolerance always unsupported when supplied. No shape/topology/history/volume-equivalence mode.

sections.title: Comparison And Safety
sections.text: Compare SAME exported component's B-Rep-only AABB min xyz then max xyz to imported root B-Rep-only AABB: six absolute coordinate deltas, no frame alignment or dimension-only normalization. Both boxes union direct bRepBodies and allOccurrences body proxies using preciseBoundingBox in each component-local frame, which must match export. Hidden B-Rep bodies are included; graphics, construction geometry, sketches and meshes are excluded. Empty B-Rep geometry, null boxes, inverted or nonfinite bounds are refused. Opens new temporary document; finally independently attempts close(save=false) on the returned verification-owned document and activation of the previously active document if non-null, even when close returns false or throws. Import failure also attempts prior activation; without a returned document ownership is unknown and no document is guessed or closed. Scoped open Design/import API required, outside command events. No user save/close. If cleanup succeeds, the primary exception is re-raised unchanged. Cleanup failure raises RuntimeError with text I/O cleanup failed: followed by JSON {primaryError:null|{type,message},cleanupErrors:[{action,type,message}]}; ordered actions are Close verification-owned temporary document and Restore previously active document, with only failures included. The original primary exception is retained as __cause__, or the first cleanup exception if no primary exists. No success result on cleanup failure. Temporary/partial imports may remain open and activation may fail; inspect documents after errors. No geometry rollback or complete document/workspace/viewport restoration guarantee. Bounding-box agreement is weak evidence only, not shape, topology, volume, mass or feature-history equivalence.
